#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    int count = 0, sum = 0, odd = 0, even = 0;
    vector<int> al;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (a[i] % 2 != 0)
            odd++;
        else
            even++;
        if (i != n - 1) {
            if (odd == even)
                al.push_back(abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
        }
    }
    sort(al.begin(), al.end());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < al.size(); ++i) {
        sum += al[i];
        if (sum <= b)
            count++;
        else
            break;
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
